evaluation.overall_comment: This is a high-quality Belarusian translation that successfully captures the conversational pacing, scientific accuracy, and reflective tone of the original podcast. The dialogue flows well for the target audience, and complex physical concepts are explained with clarity. The main detractors are a clear typographical repetition ('яе яе'), occasional missing speaker tags that slightly blur speaker attribution, and a notable terminology error regarding 'resolution' ('развязнігальнасць' instead of the standard 'раздзяляльная здольнасць'). With minor proofreading and terminology corrections, this translation would be excellent and publication-ready for a scientific podcast audience in Belarusian/Lithuanian regions using Belarusian as the primary language. It aligns well with professional standards but falls just short of perfect due to these identifiable technical and editorial lapses. Overall rating: Good/Very Good (17/20).
